messages:
Mia (growth): ok team, pre-launch checklist — we need a final pass on URL mapping + internal linking for the product webinar landing + three launch posts. who can own the redirect sweep and schema snippets?
Jordan (seo): I can take redirects and canonical rules. quick Q: do we keep /webinar/live as canonical or redirect to /webinars/2026-product-deep-dive?
Anika (content): suggest canonical -> /webinars/2026-product-deep-dive, and create /webinar/live as a temporary vanity with 301 to the canonical after the event. keeps tracking clean. :thumbsup:
Sam (ops): sounds good. also need UTM templates for email vs partner links so inbound routing doesn't split sessions. i'll add to the tracking doc.
Mia (growth): @Jordan can you also add schema for the webinar (Event schema + speakernames)? we want rich results for the replay too.
Jordan (seo): yep. I'll add `Event` + `VideoObject` structured data on the landing page and `speakernames` array. will post snippet here when ready.
Anika (content): for the three launch posts — keywords: "low-latency inference", "economical LLM serving", and "dedicated model endpoints". will map to pillar page and add internal links to the webinar replay and docs.
Jordan (seo): good targets. recommend short canonical URLs: `/solutions/low-latency-inference`, `/pricing/economics-llm-serving`, `/docs/dedicated-endpoints` and link from posts to those.
SEO-Bot: crawl-summary: 42 pages flagged with duplicate titles; 6 redirects 302 -> need 301; missing `og:image` on 4 landing pages. full report: https://redwood.ai/internal/seo/reports/2145678901
Mia (growth): @Sam please run a redirect sweep for any 302s and produce a small migration map. We can't afford broken links in partner emails next week.
Sam (ops): on it. will output CSV with columns `from,to,status,notes`. ETA EOD today.
Jordan (seo): snippet for schema to drop into CMS (I'll paste):
```
{
  "@context": "https://schema.org",
  "@type": "Event",
  "name": "Redwood Product Deep Dive",
  "startDate": "2026-05-12T17:00:00Z",
  "performer": [{"@type":"Person","name":"Anika Patel"},{"@type":"Person","name":"Devon Lee"}],
  "workExample": {"@type":"VideoObject","name":"Webinar replay","url":"https://redwood.ai/webinars/2026-product-deep-dive/replay"}
}
```
Anika (content): perfect. i'll add speaker bios and CTA to watch replay + download whitepaper.
Mia (growth): inbound routing: we need lead sink mapping — webinars -> SDR queue A, launch posts -> product-nurture sequence. @Sam can you map UTM -> queue rules in HubSpot?
Sam (ops): will do. will also add a rule: `utm_campaign=product_launch_2026` -> queue: product-nurture, `utm_source=webinar-email` -> queue: sdr-immediate.
Jordan (seo): one more thing: internal link audit — ensure anchor texts vary (not all "learn more"). i'll make a small anchor plan and push to the content doc.
Mia (growth): love that. deadline: final URL map + redirect CSV + schema snippets + UTM routing by EOD tomorrow. small wins first: can we ship redirect CSV by EOD today?
Sam (ops): redirect CSV by EOD.
Anika (content): content updates staged in CMS by tomorrow morning.
Jordan (seo): I'll run a final preflight crawl after Sam's CSV applied and ping y'all with any leftover issues.
Mia (growth): thanks team! I'll compile a release checklist and share in the channel. :rocket:
